page.layout: One text column, full width, with a printed ornamental border above. Heading "AMICO AUTHORI" with subtitle "Et Doctissimo defendenti." above a numbered section "I." and then the verse, which runs down the column. No margin notes, running head or page number.

main_text.l: AMICO AUTHORI
I.
Dissimilis nos vena tenet,nec Carbasa ventus
Pellit idem, vario labuntur tempora cursu,
Cura animos diversa tenet, hic bella Mavortis,
Heroumquè animos, & fortia pectora bello
Coelo æquat, laetosquè jubet sperare triumphos.
Ille peregrinos mores, & dissona Jura
Carpit limitibus nunquam digressus avitis.
Nec quicquam, nisi quod puerili blacterat ore
Miratur. Patriâ tantum mensdiscit in umbra.
Hic velut antiquus tutator veteris aurei
Mercibus immoritur, studioquè senescit ha-
bendi.
Incubat ille foris, coecumq; in pectore vulnus
Suspirat: nunc laetus aquas, nunc tristis in auras
Mentem oculosquè levat, nunc priscum ejurat
amorem
Transfuga, nunc Dominæ timet amisisse favo-
rem
Sed te sancta tenet flammâ meliore Camoena
Mysta elues, tacitò verbi correptus amore;
Tu

page.notes: The "Tu" at the bottom right is a catchword (the next page begins with it). "I." is a bare section number, so it is a paragraph, not a heading. The printed text has "tenet,nec" and "mensdiscit" with no space; kept as printed. The verse is set as a single stanza, so it is one paragraph. The dropcap D is joined to "Dissimilis". Ornamental border above the heading is not transcribed.
